title: Switched-off record-keeping and the freeze
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0131 no longer matches the current design.
decision: There is no gate to switch off (0143): the freeze is held by review and by the record of who made each change.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
